offering_description.value: Owns and operates outdoor advertising displays, including billboards, transit displays and logo signs, and sells advertising space to local, regional and national advertisers. It leases sites and builds, maintains and sells digital and static display faces across the United States and Canada.

primary_services.value: billboard advertising; digital billboard advertising; transit advertising; logo sign advertising; airport advertising

customer_segment.value: B2B: local, regional and national advertisers and advertising agencies, including small businesses, restaurants, healthcare and retail brands; B2G: state transportation departments for logo sign programs and municipal transit authorities

revenue_model.value: service fees: advertisers pay for display space on billboards, transit and logo signs, typically under short-term contracts; project or contract: long-term logo sign and airport advertising contracts with government agencies

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates billboard structures on leased land, selling ad space to advertisers and agencies

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Canada, with billboards across nearly all U.S. states and Canadian provinces

specialization.value: niche specialist: outdoor advertising across billboards, transit displays and logo signs

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: local sales teams selling to advertisers and agencies; agents / brokers: advertising agencies and media buyers placing campaigns; online: programmatic platforms for digital billboard inventory

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: billboard permitting, zoning and size rules under federal Highway Beautification Act and state and local sign laws, REIT tax rules

notes: Organized as a REIT; exact mix of airport and transit contracts is approximate.
